description: If \(U,V\) is a named inseparable pair and \(c\) is absent from both theories and the body \(\varphi(x)\), adjoining \((\exists x\,\varphi(x))\to\varphi(c)\) to \(U\) preserves named inseparability.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.pair_witness.{u, v} {L₀ L₁ L₂ : FirstOrder.Language} {j₁ : L₀ →ᴸ L₁}
  {j₂ : L₀ →ᴸ L₂} {U : Set (L₁.Formula ℕ)} {V : Set (L₂.Formula ℕ)}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.NamedInseparable j₁ j₂ U V) (φ : L₁.BoundedFormula ℕ 1) (c : ℕ)
  (hcU : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.FreshFor c U)
  (hcV : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.FreshFor c V) (hcφ : c ∉ φ.freeVarFinset) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.NamedInseparable j₁ j₂
    (insert (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.witnessAxiom φ c) U) V
